# nxos_segment_routing (Resource)

This resource can manage the Segment Routing configuration on NX-OS devices, including SRGB label blocks, MPLS connected prefix SID mappings, SRv6 locators and Segment Routing Traffic Engineering (SR-TE) policies, on-demand colors, segment lists, affinities and PCC settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nxos_segment_routing" "example" {
  admin_state                    = "enabled"
  instance_admin_state           = "enabled"
  instance_control               = "stateful-ha"
  srgb_allocation_retry_interval = 120
  srgb_cleanup_interval          = 90
  global_blocks = {
    "mpls" = {
      label_blocks = {
        "srgb-1" = {
          minimum_label = 17000
          maximum_label = 25999
        }
      }
    }
  }
  domains = {
    "default" = {
      address_families = {
        "ipv4" = {
          name = "AF1"
          connected_prefix_sid_maps = {
            "mpls" = {
              prefix_sids = {
                "1.1.1.1/32" = {
                  sid_value      = 17001
                  sid_value_type = "absolute"
                }
              }
            }
          }
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
  - Choices: `enabled`, `disabled`
- `affinity_colors` (Attributes Map) List of affinity colors and their bit position in the affinity bit map.
  - Map key: `name` - User defined named of the affinity Color Affinity Name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--affinity_colors))
- `deletion_policy` (String) What happens on the device when objects managed by the resource are removed. `delete` deletes the object on destroy, including any configuration not managed by Terraform, and deletes single child objects once none of their attributes are configured anymore, unless the device holds other entries below them. `reset` deletes the objects created by the resource on destroy, resets the managed attributes of the objects that already existed and leaves configuration not managed by Terraform in place. `retain` leaves the device unchanged on destroy and only removes the resource from the state. Overrides the `deletion_policy` of the provider, which defaults to `delete`. See the [Deletion Policy](../guides/deletion_policy) guide for details.
  - Choices: `delete`, `reset`, `retain`
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `domains` (Attributes Map) List of Segment Routing domains.
  - Map key: `name` - The name of the object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains))
- `global_blocks` (Attributes Map) List of Segment Routing Global Block configurations.
  - Map key: `type` - SRGB type.
  - Key choices: `mpls`, `ipv6` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--global_blocks))
- `instance_admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
  - Choices: `enabled`, `disabled`
- `instance_control` (String) The control state.

- `liveness_detection_bfd_admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.

- `liveness_detection_interval` (Number) Interval for liveness detection.

- `liveness_detection_multiplier` (Number) Multiplier for liveness detection.
  - Range: `1`-`10`
- `liveness_detection_oam_admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
  - Choices: `enabled`, `disabled`
- `on_demand_colors` (Attributes Map) List of on-demand colors.

- `pcc_source_address` (String) Local IP address to use as the source address for PCEP connections.

  - Range: `1`-`65535`
- `srv6_admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
  - Choices: `enabled`, `disabled`
- `srv6_encapsulation_source_address` (String) IPv6 address.
- `srv6_encapsulation_source_interface` (String) Interface, most likely a loopback.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to       = nxos_segment_routing.example
  identity = {}
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema


#### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# Terraform's `import` block requires a non-empty `id` value, so this format cannot be used to
# import nxos_segment_routing for the default device. Use the `terraform import` command
# below, or identity-based import shown above, instead.
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import nxos_segment_routing.example ""
```
